content.value: A single phase half wave AC voltage converter feeds a load of R = 20 Ω with an input voltage of 230 V, 50 Hz. Firing angle of thyristor is $4 5 ^ { \circ }$ . Determine (i) rms value of output voltage, (ii) power delivered to load and (iii) average input current.
